subject: Error installing MKL Math Libraries after installing RRO 3.2.1

messages.author: 47b9eece9c673367
messages.subject: Error installing MKL Math Libraries after installing RRO 3.2.1
parts:
Hi everyone,
 
I am trying to install RRO 3.2.1 and the MKL Math Libraries. Installing RRO 3.2.1 while making sure that the 'save number version in registry' have been check works but installing the MKL library generates an error 'RRO 3.2.1 could not be detected. This installer will not be able to detect RRO if RRO was installed with the option to "Save version number in registry” unchecked. Please install RRO with this option enabled'.
 
I checked the registry and I can see 2 keys (Default) and InstallPath under R/3.2.1 and R64/3.2.1
 
I am sure this is something that comes up often and I wasn't wondering if anyone could help with that please?
 
Thanks,
 
Ronald

messages.author: b92b0e53baf64e49
messages.subject: Re: Error installing MKL Math Libraries after installing RRO 3.2.1
parts:
Hi Ronald,

On Windows, Revolution R Open 3.2.1 can work side-by-side with any other version of CRAN R, including past version of RRO. In order to continue working with a different version of R from a terminal window, you must specify the full path to the R executable you want to use.

After the installation of RRO 3.2.1, you can launch Rgui.exe to start interacting with R.

For example, if you installed Revolution R Open 8.0.0 and then upgraded to Revolution R Open 3.2.1, here is how you could work with them side-by-side:

  • Start RRO 3.2.1 by executing C:\Program Files\RRO\R-3.2.1\bin\x64\Rgui.exe if that is where you installed RRO 3.2.1.
  • Start RRO 8.0.0 by executing C:\Program Files\RRO\R-3.1.1\bin\x64\Rgui.exe if that is where you installed RRO 8.0.0.

Hope that helps!

messages.author: 2aed7cbfca222ffd
messages.subject: Re: Error installing MKL Math Libraries after installing RRO 3.2.1
parts:
Hi Ronald,

This is a known problem with the MKL Installer on Windows when installing as a user who does not have administrative rights.
The MKL Installer needs administrative rights to successfully install on Windows systems.

Unfortunately, their is currently no way around this. You will need to have someone with admin rights install the software for you on your system.


Stephen Weller
Revolution R Open Technical Support
